{{Vanilla|Mud}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Mud''' is a soft, wet block. [[Matcha Flavoured]] lets it be made from [[dirt]] and a water bottle, and turned into clay.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Eight dirt around a [[Glass Bottle#Water bottle|water bottle]] make 8 mud; the empty bottle is given back.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/mud.json}}</ref> Mud still forms when a water bottle is used on dirt, as in vanilla.

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* Eight mud and a water bottle make 4 [[clay]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/clay_from_mud_and_potion.json}}</ref>
* Eight mud and a piece of [[straw]] make 8 [[Packed Mud|packed mud]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/packed_mud_from_wheat.json}}</ref>
